annotations.exact_quote: NLCF adds a local coordinate constraint into the standard NMF objective function.
annotations.reason_zh: 论文以标准NMF目标函数为基础，加入局部坐标约束提出NLCF，属于非负矩阵分解方法。

annotations.exact_quote: each data point can be represented by a linear combination of only few nearby basis vectors, which naturally leads to sparse representation.
annotations.reason_zh: 局部坐标约束使每个数据点由少数邻近基向量线性组合表示，摘要明确说明这带来稀疏表示。

abstentions.reason_zh: 摘要提到feature extraction/image representation，但未明确低维映射或维度压缩目标，不足以按定义判定为降维。
